mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing water loss with drinking was most worthwhile: the planned pictures distinguish kidney conservation from intestinal replacement and show the gradual feedback response.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the pathway to the body was necessary but comparatively predictable; its picture mainly assembled the existing components.

surprise.text: The drinking-water result showed fewer collecting-duct water channels as ADH release falls, making the return toward the usual range more concrete.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the switch from nerve activity to hormone release needed the explanation supplied with the pituitary connection.

continue.text: I would continue: the water-control sequence connected several organs through a clear feedback mechanism, though the assembly steps were fairly predictable.
